top1.title: 【2026-10-30】Mistral、1兆パラメータの「Large 4」重みを公開、サイバー防御への活用を訴求
top1.lead1: MistralがLarge 4のモデル重みを公開。企業や政府が自前の環境で導入できるようになった。
top1.lead2: サイバー防御での活用とデータ管理の自由度を訴求。競合に対する性能・効率の優位性は同社の主張だ。

top10.title: [2026-10-30] Mistral releases weights for trillion-parameter Large 4, touting cybersecurity defense applications
top10.summary: Mistral has released the model weights for Large 4. Companies and governments can deploy it themselves, with cybersecurity defense among its intended uses. Claims of superior performance and efficiency come from the company.

top10.title: [2026-10-30] Gemini adds document and PDF creation and editing within chats
top10.summary: Gemini has begun rolling out file preview and editing features to all users. PDFs are supported on the web and mobile, while other formats are currently limited to the web.

top10.title: [2026-10-30] OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings announces acquisition of security giant ADT
top10.summary: Thrive Holdings announced that it will acquire ADT at an equity valuation of approximately $7.6 billion. It aims to strengthen the business using AI, but no specific new products have been announced.

top10.title: [2026-10-30] Analysis: Microsoft's AI spending and workforce cuts, including voluntary buyout offers to about 60,000 employees
top10.summary: An analysis by The Verge reports that Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to approximately 60,000 employees. It examines the move in the context of cost and workforce reductions intended to sustain AI infrastructure investment.

top10.title: [2026-10-30] US intelligence agencies reportedly investigated outreach to Nvidia CEO; company denies sharing confidential information
top10.summary: US authorities reportedly investigated contacts between an AI cloud company executive and Nvidia's CEO. Nvidia said the interactions were routine customer engagement and denied sharing confidential information.

top10.title: [2026-10-30] Meta launches Style Sketch, an AI app that suggests outfits using clothes users already own
top10.summary: Meta's Style Sketch is available in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand. Users can add clothing items from photos, receive outfit suggestions and virtually try on clothes tailored to their body shape and skin tone.

top10.title: [2026-10-30] Dream, founded by a former Palantir executive, raises $17 million for an AI world model for architecture
top10.summary: Dream has raised $17 million in a round led by a16z. It aims to assist with designs that account for physics and building codes and, according to its founder, is being used on 10 projects in the United States.

top10.title: [2026-10-30] Granola launches voice input across Mac apps
top10.summary: Granola, an AI meeting-notes tool, has launched a voice input feature. It can format spoken words and enter them into apps across the Mac, with support for iOS and Windows also planned.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
